data.title: Government Impersonation — Multi-Channel Payment Under Duress Indicators
data.description: Detects government impersonation APP fraud by identifying payments with government agency references made via crypto, wire, or prepaid channels to non-historical payees. FBI IC3 2025 reported $797.9 million in losses from 32,424 government impersonation complaints — an 87% increase in complaints and 97% increase in losses from 2024. The payment channel distribution is distinctive: Cryptocurrency 40%, Wire Transfer/ACH 21%, Prepaid card/Gift card 15%, Cash 14%. This rule targets payment references containing government agency names or legal terminology from customers with no prior government- related payment history, as legitimate government payments follow established patterns and channels.

enrichment_required.source: Boolean — whether payee exists in 12-month historical payment network

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for Government Impersonation Payment Detection
// Detects payments with government references to non-historical payees
(transaction_type="wire_transfer" OR transaction_type="ach_credit" OR transaction_type="crypto_purchase" OR transaction_type="prepaid_card_purchase" OR transaction_type="gift_card_purchase")
payment_reference=/IRS|SSA|Social.Security|DOJ|FBI|DEA|warrant|penalty|tax.lien|federal|treasury|immigration|customs|marshal/i
payee_in_historical_pattern="false"
| groupBy(account_id, function=[
    collect([account_holder_age, transaction_type, transaction_amount,
             transaction_date, payment_reference, payee_name]),
    count(transaction_id, as=payment_count),
    sum(transaction_amount, as=total_amount)
  ])
| sort(total_amount, order=desc)
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Government Impersonation Payment Detection")`
`comment("Detects payments with government references to non-historical payees")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
  (transaction_type="wire_transfer" OR transaction_type="ach_credit"
   OR transaction_type="crypto_purchase" OR transaction_type="prepaid_card_purchase"
   OR transaction_type="gift_card_purchase")
  payee_in_historical_pattern="false"
| regex payment_reference="(?i)(IRS|SSA|Social.Security|DOJ|FBI|DEA|warrant|penalty|tax.lien|federal|treasury|immigration|customs|marshal)"
| stats count AS payment_count, sum(transaction_amount) AS total_amount,
    dc(transaction_type) AS channel_diversity,
    values(transaction_type) AS channels,
    values(payment_reference) AS references,
    values(payee_name) AS payees
    by account_id, account_holder_age
| eval risk_score = case(
    channel_diversity >= 2 AND total_amount > 10000, "critical",
    account_holder_age >= 60 AND total_amount > 5000, "critical",
    total_amount > 10000, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| sort - total_amount

references: FBI IC3, 2025 Internet Crime Report — Government impersonation: 32,424 complaints, $797.9M losses (87% increase)
FBI IC3 PSA250418, April 18, 2025 — FBI Warns of Scammers Impersonating the IC3
falsepositives: Legitimate tax payments to IRS via authorized payment processors
Attorney or legal service payments referencing government cases
Immigration service fees paid through authorized channels
